18 September 2026 Current Affairs in Hindi & English

➼ अनंत नाग को वर्ष 2024 के प्रतिष्ठित दादासाहब फाल्के पुरस्कार के लिए चुना गया है।
Anant Nag has been selected for the prestigious Dadasaheb Phalke Award for the year 2024.

➼ शशि शेखर वेम्पति को पुनर्गठित केंद्रीय फिल्म प्रमाणन बोर्ड (CBFC) का अध्यक्ष नियुक्त किया गया है।
Shashi Shekhar Vempati has been appointed as the Chairperson of the reconstituted Central Board of Film Certification (CBFC).

➼ प्रीता वर्मा ने बिहार की पहली महिला प्रभारी पुलिस महानिदेशक (DGP) के रूप में पदभार संभाला है।
Preeta Verma has taken charge as the first woman acting Director General of Police (DGP) of Bihar.

➼ EPFO के तहत अनिवार्य कवरेज के लिए संशोधित मासिक वेतन सीमा ₹25,000 कर दी गई है, जो पहले ₹15,000 थी।
The revised monthly wage limit for mandatory coverage under EPFO has been increased to ₹25,000, from ₹15,000.

➼ छोटे व्यापारियों (P2PM श्रेणी) के लिए UPI MDR शुल्क से मुक्त रहने हेतु अधिकतम मासिक लेनदेन सीमा ₹1 लाख है।
The maximum monthly transaction limit for small merchants (P2PM category) to remain exempt from UPI MDR charges is ₹1 lakh.

➼ भारतीय सेना प्रमुख जनरल धीरज सेठ ने सितंबर 2026 में रूस की आधिकारिक यात्रा शुरू की है।
Indian Army Chief General Dheeraj Seth has embarked on an official visit to Russia in September 2026.

➼ 17 सितंबर से शुरू हुए राष्ट्रव्यापी ‘स्वच्छता ही सेवा 2026’ अभियान की थीम “स्वच्छता में सहभाग, स्वच्छ भारत, विकसित भारत” है।
The theme of the nationwide ‘Swachhata Hi Seva 2026’ campaign is “Swachhata Mein Sahbhag, Swachh Bharat, Viksit Bharat.”

➼ पंजाब और हरियाणा के किसान पराली न जलाने के लिए कार्बन क्रेडिट भुगतान प्राप्त करने वाले भारत के पहले किसान बने हैं।
Farmers from Punjab and Haryana became the first in India to receive carbon credit payments for not burning stubble.

➼ गृह मंत्रालय ने Shahzad Bhatti Network (SBN) को UAPA के तहत आतंकवादी संगठन घोषित किया है।
The Ministry of Home Affairs has declared the Shahzad Bhatti Network (SBN) a terrorist organization under UAPA.

➼ भारत का पहला AI-संचालित रेल इंजन WAP-7, जिसमें स्वचालित OHE निरीक्षण प्रणाली लगी है, का निर्माण Patiala Locomotive Works (PLW), Punjab में किया गया।
India’s first AI-powered locomotive WAP-7, equipped with an automatic OHE inspection system, was manufactured at Patiala Locomotive Works (PLW), Punjab.

➼ भारत में निर्मित पहली उन्नत स्वदेशी एंडोस्कोपी प्रणाली EP-6000 को AIIMS, New Delhi में स्थापित किया गया है।
India’s first indigenously manufactured advanced endoscopy system EP-6000 has been installed at AIIMS, New Delhi.

➼ IIM Bangalore ने QS Global MBA Rankings 2027 में भारत में शीर्ष स्थान प्राप्त किया और वैश्विक स्तर पर 64वां स्थान हासिल किया।
IIM Bangalore ranked at the top in India in the QS Global MBA Rankings 2027, securing 64th position globally.

➼ हाल ही में चर्चा में रहा Sonai Rupai Wildlife Sanctuary असम में स्थित है।
The recently discussed Sonai Rupai Wildlife Sanctuary is located in Assam.

➼ WEF Global Gender Gap Index 2026 में भारत 131वें स्थान पर रहा, जो 145 देशों में से है।
India ranked 131st out of 145 countries in the WEF Global Gender Gap Index 2026.

➼ Iceland ने Global Gender Gap Index 2026 में प्रथम स्थान प्राप्त किया।
Iceland secured the first position in the Global Gender Gap Index 2026

📝"Gerans" on Deployment📝
How might North Korea use the new drones?

A new report from a monitoring group shed light on cooperation between Russia and North Korea in the field of drone production. Whether the data is actually accurate remains unknown, but there's another interesting angle here.

The group includes representatives from South Korea, Japan and the USA. And they are likely far more concerned not with sanctions compliance — after all, if North Korea acquires drones from the "Geranium" series, it will deal another blow to the security of all three countries.

In Seoul, Tokyo and Washington, they understand that acquiring the same "Geran-5s" would give North Koreans even more capability to strike key targets in the region. The most vulnerable point, of course, is the completely exposed South Korean territory, but Japan could also take hits if things escalate.

🔻North Korea's Priority Targets:

▪️On the territory of North Korea's Asian neighbors, important American bases are concentrated. For example, Camp Humphreys serves as the headquarters of US forces in South Korea, and US Air Force assets are concentrated at airbases Osan and Kunsan, while the naval facility in Sasebo could also be hit. Military installations of Japanese and South Korean forces will also be tempting targets for "Geraniums."

▪️North Koreans clearly won't forget about the economy either. Literally 100 kilometers from the demilitarized zone lies the world's largest cluster of Samsung factories — the company ranks second only to Taiwan's TSMC in chip production. If a strike disrupts operations at these facilities, it would hurt not only South Korea's budget but the global technology industry as well.

▪️And if Pyongyang decides to halt South Korea's economy altogether, they would pull out a map showing oil refineries and energy facilities like power plants. Since the southern neighbor depends on energy imports and relies on exporting its goods due to its economic structure, major ports could well become the next targets.

▪️The same applies to Japan. In the country, within the strike radius of "Geraniums," there are several large fuel storage facilities and refineries, as well as port installations — just one port, Nagoya, handles one of the world's largest cargo flows. Factories of Toyota, Mitsubishi Heavy Industries, and technology companies could also come under fire.

📌North Korea is clearly watching closely what's happening in so-called Ukraine and the Middle East. This is indicated by their recent practice of combined strikes — North Koreans hit with both missiles and drones. In other words, Pyongyang hasn't forgotten about scenarios involving air defense saturation of a potential adversary and destruction of important targets.

❗️And the Geran-5 drones, in theory, would help bring such plans to life in the event of a conflict. An American and allied attack on North Korea would already be costly, considering the presence of nuclear weapons. But if relations deepen with Russia, that cost risks becoming even higher.

#Citizenship

The Citizenship Act of 1955 prescribes five ways of acquiring citizenship, viz, birth, descent, registration, naturalisation and incorporation of territory: 

🔺️ BY BIRTH

🔸️ A person born in India on or after January 26, 1950 but before July 1, 1987 is a citizen of India by birth irrespective of the nationality of his  parents. 

🔸️ A person born in India on or after July 1, 1987 is considered as a citizen of India only if either of his parents is a citizen of India at the time of his birth. 

🔸️ Further, those born in India on or after December 3, 2004 are considered citizens of India only if both of their parents are citizens of  India or one of whose parents is a citizen of India and the other is not an  illegal migrant at the time of their birth.
 
🔸️ The children of foreign diplomats posted in India and enemy aliens  cannot acquire Indian citizenship by birth.

1. 18वें BRICS शिखर सम्मेलन में सदस्य देशों के बीच महामारी के खतरों की निगरानी और उनसे निपटने के लिए BRICS Integrated Early Warning System की घोषणा की गई।
   The BRICS Integrated Early Warning System was announced at the 18th BRICS Summit to monitor and respond to epidemic threats among member countries.

2. सितंबर 2026 में चौथा भारत-जर्मनी पर्यावरण मंच “Together For More Resilience” थीम के तहत आयोजित किया गया।
   The 4th Indo-German Environment Forum was held in September 2026 under the theme “Together For More Resilience.”

3. भारत ने श्रीलंका को हराकर महिला एशिया कप क्रिकेट टूर्नामेंट 2026 का खिताब जीता।
   India won the Women's Asia Cup cricket tournament 2026 title by defeating Sri Lanka.

4. भारत ने दक्षिण कोरिया को 4-1 से हराकर चीन में आयोजित पुरुष जूनियर एशिया कप हॉकी 2026 का खिताब जीता।
   India won the Men's Junior Asia Cup Hockey 2026 title held in China by defeating South Korea 4-1.

5. भारत ने चीन को 1-0 से हराकर महिला जूनियर एशिया कप हॉकी 2026 का खिताब जीता।
   India won the Women's Junior Asia Cup Hockey 2026 title by defeating China 1-0.

6. गंजेस ग्रैंडमास्टर्स ने बेंगलुरु में आयोजित टेक महिंद्रा ग्लोबल चेस लीग (GCL) का खिताब जीता।
   Ganges Grandmasters won the Tech Mahindra Global Chess League (GCL) title held in Bengaluru.

7. कजाकिस्तान की एलेना रायबाकिना ने 2026 यूएस ओपन टेनिस चैंपियनशिप में महिला एकल का खिताब जीता।
   Kazakhstan's Elena Rybakina won the women's singles title at the 2026 US Open Tennis Championships.

8. बी. धीरज (धीरज बोम्मादेवरा) ने साल्टिलो, मैक्सिको में आयोजित तीरंदाजी विश्व कप फाइनल में पुरुषों के रिकर्व वर्ग में ऐतिहासिक स्वर्ण पदक जीता।
   B. Dhiraj (Dhiraj Bommadevara) won a historic gold medal in the men's recurve category at the Archery World Cup Final held in Saltillo, Mexico.

9. मर्सिडीज के किमी एंटोनेली ने स्पैनिश ग्रां प्री 2026 का खिताब जीता।
   Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli won the Spanish Grand Prix 2026 title.

10. जापान का आइची-नागोया शहर 19 सितंबर से 4 अक्टूबर 2026 तक 20वें एशियाई खेलों की मेजबानी कर रहा है।
    Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, is hosting the 20th Asian Games from September 19 to October 4, 2026.

11. ‘Woman Unknown’ फिल्म ने 83वें वेनिस अंतरराष्ट्रीय फिल्म महोत्सव में प्रतिष्ठित गोल्डन लायन (सर्वश्रेष्ठ फिल्म) पुरस्कार जीता।
    The film ‘Woman Unknown’ won the prestigious Golden Lion (Best Film) award at the 83rd Venice International Film Festival.

12. जॉन मालकोविच ने 83वें वेनिस अंतरराष्ट्रीय फिल्म महोत्सव में सर्वश्रेष्ठ अभिनेता का वोल्पी कप जीता।
    John Malkovich won the Volpi Cup for Best Actor at the 83rd Venice International Film Festival.

13. मलेशिया के प्रधानमंत्री अनवर इब्राहिम को कोझिकोड में शेख अबू बकर फाउंडेशन द्वारा स्थापित पहला ‘उत्कृष्टता पुरस्कार’ प्रदान किया गया।
    Anwar Ibrahim, Prime Minister of Malaysia, was awarded the first ‘Excellence Award’ instituted by the Sheikh Aboobacker Foundation in Kozhikode.

14. जिंदल स्टील और CSIR-CRRI द्वारा स्टील स्लैग से निर्मित दुनिया की सबसे लंबी 1.85 किमी लंबी चार-लेन सड़क छत्तीसगढ़ के रायगढ़ में बनाई गई।
    The world's longest 1.85-km, four-lane road constructed from steel slag by Jindal Steel and CSIR-CRRI was built in Raigarh, Chhattisgarh.

15. बीजिंग में आयोजित वर्ल्ड ह्यूमनॉइड रोबोट गेम्स में TianGong Ultra ने 100 मीटर दौड़ में 8.64 सेकंड का रिकॉर्ड समय दर्ज किया।
    TianGong Ultra clocked a record time of 8.64 seconds in the 100-metre sprint at the World Humanoid Robot Games held in Beijing.
